prompt:
Render a high-fidelity desktop homepage UI mockup for FoodBridge, edge to edge at 1536 by 1024, crisp legible text, no browser frame or device. FoodBridge coordinates surplus food and waste collection in Sri Lanka. Donors, recipient organisations, recyclers, volunteers, and admins deserve equal visibility. The visitor's job is to understand the service and enter the right role. The visual world is a contemporary community wayfinding system: deep leaf-green information fields, clean white and pale mint grounds, sparing sunflower yellow for orientation. Broad humanist sans lettering, generous directional spacing, simple numbered destinations, restrained arrow signs; this is a usable website, not an illustrated street or poster. No fake numbers, testimonials, certifications, maps, current jobs, or impact claims.
Lead with a connected-destinations concept. The navigation reads "FoodBridge.", "How it works", "Community impact", "Sign in". The concise headline "Good food. Shared responsibility." is embedded in a large continuous wayfinding composition. Five generous, clearly labelled destination lanes meet around the FoodBridge purpose, with equal importance and all text on horizontal baselines. This is an action interface, never a geographic map or infographic alone: each lane ends in an obvious usable action. It takes greater compositional ambition than an ordinary directory, using the whole opening field for the connected role choices rather than a split hero. Use real role actions with equal prominence: "Donor — Share food or post waste"; "Recipient organisation — Register for review"; "Recycler — Register for review"; "Volunteer — Help with pickups"; "Admin — Sign in to manage". Each has a clear clickable arrow or action. Include the readable disclosure "Recipient and recycler browsing and claims are not available yet." Public admin signup must not appear.
State "Food sharing and waste collection in Sri Lanka." Beneath the connected field, show the beginning of a distinct content section titled "Food and waste take different paths" and the plain text "Edible food goes to recipient organisations. Waste is collected separately." A slim editorial community food handover photo can support that section, without invented evidence. Keep navigation, text contrast and role actions unmistakably usable.
